description.en:
[Doubao Seedream 5.0 · Flagship Image Generation]
▸ What it does: Turn a text prompt into ultra-high-resolution images — 3.7M+ pixels, starting from 2048×2048.
▸ Highlights: ByteDance's newest flagship — best-in-class Chinese semantic understanding, a balanced blend of realism and artistry, and abundant detail.
▸ Perfect for: posters, covers & illustrations / e-commerce hero shots / China-market campaigns / concept design / fine-art creation.
▸ Edge: direct China connectivity with zero cross-border lag, native Chinese-prompt support, and custom seeds for reproducible results
description.zh:
【豆包 Seedream 5.0 · 旗舰图片生成】
▸ 能做什么: 文字描述 → 超高分辨率图片 (≥3.7M 像素 ~ 2048x2048 起步)
▸ 亮点: 字节最新旗舰, 中文语义理解业内领先, 真实感和艺术风格均衡, 细节丰富
▸ 典型场景: 海报/封面/插画创作 / 电商主图 / 中文场景营销 / 概念设计 / 艺术创作
▸ 优势: 国内直连 / 无跨境延迟 / 中文提示词原生支持 / 支持自定义种子复现

description.en:
[Qwen-Image 2.0 Pro · Core Workhorse Image Generation]
▸ What it does: text-to-image + image-to-image + text rendering + multi-image blending + multi-image sequences — up to 6 images per request.
▸ Highlights: Tongyi Qianwen's latest image model — excellent Chinese semantic understanding and pixel-accurate Chinese text rendering inside images (a must for posters and covers).
▸ Perfect for: e-commerce hero shots / social visuals / article covers / ad assets / typographic posters / multi-image story sequences.
▸ Edge: direct China connectivity with low latency and friendly pricing — the go-to for everyday, high-frequency creation
description.zh:
【Qwen-Image 2.0 Pro · 基础主力款图像生成】
▸ 能做什么: 文生图 + 图生图 + 文字渲染 + 多图融合 + 多图连续 (单次最多 6 张)
▸ 亮点: 通义千问最新图像模型, 中文语义理解优秀, 支持在图片中精准渲染中文文字 (海报/封面必备)
▸ 典型场景: 电商主图 / 社媒配图 / 公众号封面 / 广告素材 / 文字海报 / 多图故事连续生成
▸ 优势: 国内直连低延迟, 成本亲民, 适合全量用户日常高频创作

[Wan 2.7 Image Pro · Premium Flagship Image Generation]
▸ What it does: 2K resolution (2048×2048) + precise local editing (box-select a region and swap objects) + multi-panel sequences + multi-reference style transfer.
▸ Highlights: Wan 2.7's newest flagship — industry-leading photorealism, with object detection & segmentation, viewpoint editing, and subject-feature preservation.
▸ Perfect for: professional poster design / premium ad creative / brand visuals / film concept art / game key art / architectural renders.
▸ Edge: 2K fidelity rivaling Midjourney — built for the advanced needs of professional creators and designers
description.zh:
【Wan 2.7 Image Pro · 高端旗舰款图像生成】
▸ 能做什么: 2K 高分辨率 (2048×2048) + 精准局部编辑 (框选区域换物) + 多格连续图 + 多参考图风格迁移

▸ 典型场景: 专业海报设计 / 高端广告创意 / 品牌视觉 / 影视概念图 / 游戏原画 / 建筑效果图
▸ 优势: 2K 分辨率保真度媲美 Midjourney, 针对专业创作者和设计师的进阶场景

description.en:
[OpenAI GPT Image 2 - High-fidelity text-to-image]
- What it does: turns a text description into a single high-quality image, from 1K up to 4K (3840x2160)
- Highlights: strong prompt adherence and legible in-image text; fixed high quality output, no quality knob to get wrong
- Typical uses: posters and covers, marketing creatives, concept art, illustrations
- Note: pick the size before generating - it decides both the output resolution and the credits charged
description.zh:
【OpenAI GPT Image 2 · 高保真文生图】
▸ 能做什么: 文字描述 → 单张高质量图片, 覆盖 1K 至 4K(3840×2160)
▸ 亮点: 提示词遵循度高, 图内文字清晰可读; 固定高画质输出, 无需纠结画质档
▸ 典型场景: 海报与封面 / 营销素材 / 概念设计 / 插画创作
▸ 提示: 生成前先选尺寸 —— 它同时决定出图分辨率与消耗积分

description.en:
[WanX Style Repaint V1 · Fun Portrait Restyling for Growth]
▸ What it does: one tap turns a portrait photo into comic, 3D cartoon, anime, Chinese-style, sci-fi, and many more preset art styles.
▸ Highlights: 10+ curated preset styles, zero-effort one-tap output, plus custom style reference images (style_index=-1).
▸ Perfect for: social avatars / feed decoration / holiday-themed avatars / restyled Spring Festival family photos / school graduation shots.
▸ Edge: ultra-affordable and great value, with 500 free credits for new users — a consumer-facing fun feature tailor-made for new-user acquisition and viral sharing.
▸ Note: needs a clear portrait photo (face well-framed); asynchronous API, results in roughly 5–15s
description.zh:
【WanX Style Repaint V1 · 引流娱乐款人像风格化】
▸ 能做什么: 一键把人像照片转换为漫画/3D卡通/二次元/国风/未来科技等多种预设艺术风格
▸ 亮点: 10+ 精选预置风格, 零门槛一键出图, 支持自定义风格参考图 (style_index=-1)
▸ 典型场景: 社交头像生成 / 朋友圈装饰 / 节日主题头像 / 春节全家福风格化 / 学校毕业照
▸ 优势: 成本极低、超高性价比, 新用户赠 500 张免费额度, 面向 C 端娱乐场景, 适合新用户引流和病毒传播
▸ 注意: 需要清晰人像照 (脸部占比合适), 异步接口, 约 5-15 秒出图
